articles.summary: Nemesis is an automated adversarial red-teaming framework developed at GoDaddy to continuously stress-test our Generative AI agents against agent specific prompt injection, jailbreaks, and social engineering attacks. Nemesis tries to break our agents in a safe and observable environment before a real hacker does.
articles.title: Beyond SAST: Automating AI Agent Security with Nemesis

articles.summary: On an iOS prototype with Claude Code in the loop, we burned tokens on file reads and wrong guesses when the device's real behavior was unclear. Scoped, consistent logs in Console worked as runtime documentation and cut estimated session spend by about 40%, for engineers and for the assistant alike.
articles.title: Logs As Runtime Documentation
